body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) as a platform-readings candidate for the fifth readings increment (after the ceiling ruling on #15960). Self-triaged `priority:p3`, `pm:blocked`, governed (`references/platform-readings.md`).

Blocked-by: #15960

## Measured

- Four cards this seat created today through the MCP `issue_write create` path (#15959, #15960, #15961, objectui#7775) were all stored WITHOUT the trailing `---` + `_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_` block that was sent; the rest of each body was intact. The `domain:cli` seat measured the same on #15971 and #15969 (its 16:53Z comment on #15971), while an identical block survived on a PR body created minutes apart.
- The title's angle-bracket span is eaten on the same path: #15971 was sent as ``OS_ALLOW_MAIN_EDITS=1 <cmd>`` and stored without `<cmd>` (also seen earlier on #15858).
- A REST `PATCH /issues/{n}` with the body re-sent plus the footer stored it verbatim and read back identical (the four cards above, 17:1xZ) — consistent with the existing reading that an issue-body PATCH appends nothing.

## The rule to land (one or two lines, `platform-readings.md` 读数陷阱 write-side cluster)

- Issue creation through the MCP path drops the trailing footer block and any `<…>` span in the title: create issues through REST `POST /issues`, or read the stored body back and `PATCH` the footer on; spell title placeholders as `NAME` or `:id`, never `<…>`.

## Dedup

Not a duplicate of the sanitizer lines already in the ledger (HTML-comment-shaped markers stripped; lone angle brackets survive in bodies): those describe body content, this is issue CREATION dropping a trailing block and a TITLE span.
